title: Minimum Meeting Rooms
statement:
Given a list of meeting time intervals [start, end], find the minimum number of conference rooms required to hold all meetings without overlap.

Two meetings overlap if one starts before the other ends.

Use a min-heap of end times for an O(N log N) solution.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The next N lines each contain two integers: start and end.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum number of meeting rooms required.

examples.explanation: Meeting [0,30] overlaps with [5,10] and [15,20]. Need 2 rooms.
Meetings don't overlap; one room suffices.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
intervals = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
# Write your solution here
# Hint: sort by start; push end times into min-heap;
